# HOME ENG

![](https://www.artinessreality.com/wp/wp-content/themes/artiness/img/barretta-rossa-verticale.png)

We develop

innovative technologies

for medical doctors,

with medical doctors.

![](https://www.artinessreality.com/wp/wp-content/themes/artiness/img/mouse.png)

Artiness is developing an advanced software platform that transform medical imaging data into patient-specific 3D models and immersive mixed-reality environments, enabling a new standard of real-time intra-procedural navigation for minimally invasive cardiovascular interventions.

###### ![ARTICOR-LOGOTIPO](https://www.artinessreality.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/ARTICOR-LOGOTIPO-300x48.png)

ARTICOR® is a next-generation software platform for physicians and surgeons that combines patient-specific 3D planning with real-time intra-procedural navigation of cardiovascular interventions in Mixed Reality.

By enabling shared holographic visualization and real-time interaction, ARTICOR® supports coordinated clinical decision-making during complex procedures through secure and easy-to-use digital tools.

ARTICOR® is currently under development and is not yet certified as a medical device for intra-procedural clinical use.
